## Change and evidence

Describe the dataset, protocol, result, or correction, and link its primary sources with table/row or leaderboard entry locations.

## Comparison review

- [ ] The intention target and annotation provenance are explicit.
- [ ] Dataset version, split, sample selection, modalities, timing, training policy, and metric match the benchmark.
- [ ] Every score has an original source and a precise locator.
- [ ] Claims of verification and official first place match what was actually checked.
- [ ] Generated Markdown and validation commands pass.
